text: So the game is amazing. Graphics are great cards nice and easy to drag around the field. But lately I have been having some problems. When I try to join the Modern Day Challenge or something like that the percentage goes up slowly and when it hits 100 it crashes and when I click on Clash Royale it crashes. So I have to restart the app every time I want to go back but still cannot join a game. Overall a very good app

I've played the game since day 1 and it was such a joy to play and everything was so awesome about it,but unfortunately now, everything has changed,the devs and the company has taken the joy from it,it's pay to win ,same cycle decks that's needed to win,no strat ,just cycle and win, idiotic heroes, evos and everything is behind a paywall, I'm sorry Supercell but I literally hate u guys for ruining something I used love with all my heart ,and I'll never ever forgive u guys for it.uve taken my joy
Fully pay to win Totally Biased Every time your enemy troops are 1 level higher than yours

this new update is terrible!! i have to rate it 1 star to show how far backward you have gone!!! its things like how can you get rid of the event shop, and just chuck more onto the season pass!?... effectively you've made it harder and we won't be able to get as much value out of our time!!! making it harder to upgrade and further progress into the game. I'm going to take a break from the game now and come back when hopefully they sort something about this, because this is a joke

An amazing game but would not recommend. At first the game feels amazing, but the more you progress the more you will be at a disadvantage if you are free2play. At a certain point it simply becomes necessary to spend money on the game to have any chance to even compete. I've been playing for over 2 years and I'm not even close to maxing out a single card and in my rank (Challenger 2) every other guy has his whole deck maxed. The game had great potential but has been ruined by corporate greed.

The overall mechanics of the game are fun, though sadly it has become nothing more than a cash grab in recent years. Shop offers becoming more and more expensive and offering poor value, new overpowered cards being released which can only realistically be obtained by spending money and progression being next to impossible without buying the aforementioned offers. The game being pay to win has become even more noticeable nowadays.

It wasn't as good as it was before. This game is losing its strategic game title, it's becoming a Pay to Win game. Most players have purchased Royale Pass, and other items that they could benefit from. They have an advantage over the other free players. And one more thing, there are players who had already acquired legendary cards you moved in greater arenas. You shouldn't have moved those cards. Or at least remove the cards of other players who acuired them before. I have hopes for u supercell.

This game has become a mess. I've played since day one. It's better in some ways now than what it used to be. Progression is much easier so you can level up and get to the 'real' game. However, miss match galore. You will be destroyed repeatedly in quick succession. Clan wars are a pure mess now. Yes I may be level 13 but I'm using cards I don't use to make a 4th deck which is made of lvl 10 - 11 cards, where I am matched against a maxed level deck. No chance of winning. Pure waste of time.

Used to be a 5 star game. Is now stale and dying. Format hasn't really changed in 6 years. Most updates have been superficial to say the least. Clan Wars is trash. Needs a complete revamp. Has become a source of frustration for me; stuck at the same trophy level on ladder for years. SC, please add more modes and give us something else to do. The game is just boring now.

I have 5 bases that I have bought the monthly pass for religiously for the last year, and with the new changes, I just wanted you guys to know, it will not happen again. The decision to not allow bases to drop trophies past a certain point, currently has my th9 base stuck and unable to progress. Who decided this? Now, I play nobody I have an even somewhat fair chance to beat, and cant drop a bit to get back into fair competition. Dumb. I am finding a new game to give my money to. Thanks.

Playing since beginning. Fun and addictive gameplay stopped me from not playing. Love it. Edit-1: Experiencing improper scaling issue after the recent update. Also, 2v2 matchmaking taking forever making it unable to find a match. Edit-2: After 7 years of playing, I no longer think this game deserves my attention because of their anti F2P campaign they've started recently. Bad updates one after another makes this game not fun anymore. I guess we can call it the "Tencent effect".

For anyone not willing to spend money this game is more akin to a Sisyphian trial than it is fun. The time it takes for you to progress is tied to random chance and is greatly limited by very low daily caps. And that is without mentioning the people you will go against. Every single one of them has spent a considerable amount of money to the point where they can win via levels alone, as levels have an impact on many interactions. Either don't play, or be prepared to slog on through and pay.

Usually crash without any signals even if the game has a maintenance. I lost more than 300 points for the "Re-log in" problem, Very annoying problem, and this is the reason that I have to rate it to 2/5. Btw, the game play is good, easy to play, control and understand the strategy.

Used to be a good game but now it's not. I kept meeting the players who are higher level than me and their cards are higher. I also kept getting lower level teammates and mostly get unfair loses. Some cards are stupid too, because mostly they're relatively the same. The challenges are so boring, it's just want you to pay whenever you lose. I don't think the game will be saved now.

I played this game since 2017 and now it is in an awful condition.Since 2019, they were adding unnecessary cards to ruin the game and all of the updates were promoting the fact that we are in a situation that we need to spend money on this game. Before, when level 12 was max level, it was the perfect game. I used to love this game, but after making it broken and adding level 15 and some DAMN stuff, I deleted it and won't ever reinstall it. I thank supercell's community to destroy the game!!!!!!!

Have been playing this game since it's global launch, it's pretty addictive. The only good thing about the game is it's graphics. This game used to be a fun game but not anymore. Devs aren't paying attention to the cards that needs to be balanced. They're upgrading/balancing the cards that needs no change whatsoever. Skill used to be a major factor while climbing the ladder, but nowdays it depends more on card levels and which cards you have/use. Basically, it's pay to win game.

WARNING: DON'T PLAY THIS GAME. The algorithm of this game will always pick at least 1 lever higher than your current level. Trust me, no matter how much you try, you will always lost and get frustrated, they will pick the enemy card that you're always weak in and eventually you will force to pay $ for higher lever to go against your opponent's. But it will never end there. Eventually you understand what I mean. Even I'm a paying customers, this game doesn't make you feel good.

The game is actually fun to play, however I'm constantly being frozen out in battles, my device is not old yet it seems to bodge when I play sometimes. It wouldn't be a problem if losses weren't a big part of the rewards system, but I'm very bored of logging in, losing unnecessary crowns, and having to spend the day attempting to get back tht which was wrongfully lost. Great game, just not fun losing because of game malfunction. Uninstalled today unfortunately.

I've had many bad experiences with, especially mobile, games that are bombarded with ads or purchases, but this one takes the crown, it doesn’t have ads, but it's in-game purchases are ridiculously expensive, since you need >200€ to upgrade a card to level 12 (from 11, assuming you already collected all the cards needed for the upgrade). And when you're close to getting to a new Arena, the game intentionally pairs you with bots or pay-to-win players that have all cards at least 1-2 level higher

battle with strategy. force us to outsmart each other, this is the best part for me. but it's very hard when battle 2vs1. the chest unlock time, mission, and ads just right, no need to be changed. there are few players that don't want to trade but it's their own business. after all, this is a good game (unless the part that i have low spec phone so i often force close aftet few minutes)

App crashes way too much... The loading screens load way too long. It had happened multiple times that I try to enter a battle but it loads really slowly and by the time I enter I see that my opponent won three crowns and the match is over before I could even enter the game. It also happens that whenever I'm in the middle of a battle the app lags or crashes, and when I open the app again to play it loads really slowly again and then I end up losing trophies. Fix this and then I will rate this 5.

This game was soo good at release, but sadly turned into greedy cash grab. Good luck if you want to try spend your in-game currency in the shop. Instead it's a paywall filled with stuff that is only available to pay with real money. You wanna grab that nice looking chest that says "FREE"? well.. you need to buy the thing over it with real money if you want to access it. It's so manipulative and ridiculous. The rewards have gotten worse and worse making the progress is painfully slow.

Absolutely terrible! I downloaded the app recently after so many years, and it wouldn't allow me to log in.. This is ridiculous! I've a King level 12 account and now I can't load it just because I can't open the game, it keeps getting stuck at 'UPDATING' and then suddenly a text pops up saying 'Please try logging in again'. Devs, I want this fixed please ty

This game gives a lot of irritation . Requires a high Data connection. Additionally, placing cards takes 1 second extra , which is additional to the deploying time of cards. Secondly, chests contain cards which are least used by you and hence all the rewards are useless. Thirdly, my earlier account was hacked, so when i reported that using a new account, they blocked my new account too. So , overall, I won't recommend this game at all. IT'S FULL WASTE OF TIME.

Used to be a great game. Now it's just a frustrating terrible game. Keep matching really strong players against weak ones so we consistently keep losing. Why? Whether you pay or use the free version, the story is the same. You won't progress after a certain point. Imagine matching level 15 with a level 13. How do you go past the stupidity ? I really loved this game, now it's just a waste of time because you'll never progress! Hate the update. It's just bad!

Good game with pretty balance game state. Unfortunately, for some reason the app load extremely slow for me. For example, the game on launch will load rapidly from 0 to 84, then it take atleast a 15 second to load. This is detrimental to the early game where the opponents will be able to destroy my tower especially when they have a hog valk combo

6 years ago, I gave a 5-star review. Now, with the insane matchmaking, it deserves even less. Players that climbed the ladder with low-level cards but good strategy will find themselves impossible to enter or go further within the Leagues, since even at the bottom - Challenger III - they will be matched up with max-leveled opponents (king tower and all cards in level 14). You can't even enjoy the game anymore, 'cause regardless of your strategy, you will be against a maxed opponent.

Used to have a good review from me but supercell has become too greedy. Before you could get a lot of things by playing free. Now they reduced gold from chests and in general the ability to get stuff for free. Now u have a battle pass with 2 options to choose from which are both above 10$ for some small stuff. I have decided to stop playing this game because it just ain't fun anymore. Imagine being level 13 and fighting level 15 pay to play winners it's just not fun.

As other players have said, the game is not based on skill at all, instead It's the money you spend. And the battling problem; it sometimes puts you in battle with a player a whole level or two ahead of you, so theyre pretty much unstoppable. The game might as well just have players comparing cards & levels to each other to see whose one's better & higher than letting players battle with overpowered opponents and rage quit. The game is just about plain luck, honestly.

In-app purchases are really not clear! Be careful! I purchased something called 'Royal Pass' for $5, and only after a week I realized it was for a limited time and that I have to renew it. Really doesn’t worth theptice paid! I used to enjoy this game, but it doesn't worth it. Uninstalled it instantly when I realized support is not willing to compensate me.

I do not recommend starting this game now, except if you have a lot of money to spend. It used to be a good casual game. Now it is a pay to win. Supercell has released new evolution cards, which are the most op cards they never released. The only way to have them now is by paying. Free to play players could if grinding for 6 month for 1 card. They also released lvl 15 unreachable if you don't but hundreds in the game. I've been playing since the game release, but I'm done. Cash grab to avoid

I've played this game since launch. I miss the simplicity and the f2p aspects of the game. Ever since the lvl 15 update it seems like progressing in the game just became harder for f2p players (I'm a light spender). I used to buy the season pass before it got nerfed into oblivion. Also, broken evolutions always seem like a cash grab with them not being obtainable without paying.

if you are not planning on spending a big amount of money, DO NOT play this cashgrab of a game. they are trying their absolute hardest to make this game absolutely impossible if you do not spend money, it is the only way you can consistantly get cards and other loot. every single update they yet again make things harder for free 2 play. everytime they make a new evo you can buy it, and it is always way too overpowered when you can buy it, after that it gets nerfed to make it balanced.

I really like this game I've been playing for 2 years but it seams that all they want is money and they don't even listen to the player base they added level 16 which no one wanted and removed book so you can only upgrade if you spend money. It's not a problem if you need to spend a little money but u shouldn't need to spend 100-200 dollars to play comfortably. It's like they want to kill the game. And also why do theyake the game more pay to win every update

This game used to be so, so good. But now, they've taken all of the fun out of it for the Free-to-Play players. You genuinely cannot make progress OR have fun without paying money for in-game purchases. Chests? Gone. Free Pass? Constantly downgraded. Lucky Boxes? Reworked to become horrible. If you plan to play this game WITHOUT spending money on it, forget it. Because it's genuinely impossible to do so. Don't spend a single money on it unless they reverse all of the horrible updates.

Honestly, this game was never fun. I have been playing this game for 5 years now, and every single time I reinstall it on a new phone, I immediately uninstall it. This game has always been pay to win, but as of 2022, it's been absolutely horrible how much they've monetized this game. Every inch of this game, every single button you click, will have, in some way, monetization. If you want to progress, you need to buy your way up. And for proof, every single top player has spent over 100 dollars.

I've been playing since clash royale first came out. The game is nothing like what it used to be. It has been becoming more pay to win over time, which was alright but the most recent update has went too far. They made progression 50% harder and have put in offers with starting price tags of $50 plus. Don't download this game, and if you do, don't pay for the ludicrously priced features that they almost make mandatory.

Recent update made the game more P2W than it already was, made the game give less rewards and charges you more (up to 40x more, usually less). If you're interested in playing Clash Royale I'd highly encourage you to try Null's Royale instead, a private server. It's more fun as you can actually play with any troop you want without grinding months or paying hundreds of dollars. It really is just a more definitive way to play this game.

This game is fun to play, but in no way is it friendly to players. Pls do not play this game unless you are willing to spend money or spend hours to learn quantum mechanics just to understand how to counter every single card. I got to 2300 trophies, which is not a lot but it's enough to make me feel like I would have to spend too much time to get better. It's not a chill nor relaxing game...it's just an unnecessary grind starting at 2k trophies and it doesnt feel rewarding to win

The game used to be a lot of fun and a great way to pass time, but it has now devolved into a pay-to-win grind that is repitive and boring. The game itself is a lot of fun in the early stages, but it becomes incredibly stale, repitive and boring once you reach the higher arenas. Unless you're willing to spend hundreds of dollars, around Arena 18 the game becomes more "hoping" you dont run into a player that spent money to max everything out, but isn't skilled enough to climb any higher.

Have been playing for years and years also invested money into the game. But I cannot recommend it anymore. It has become a money grab. * Ranking system still broke for lower levels. * New cards will be introduced that are way overpowered and will make your deck out of date... * How can we make more money let's raise the card level to 14.

Game uses shady techniques(moving important buttons) to trick players into accidentally clicking purchases that use gems with zero confirmation of what you are purchasing. If you do realize what happened, that the equivalent to 5 real world dollars on what amounts to 1 card, and ask support if they can refund this incredibly shady transaction. Support will fully sympathize, but will tell you it would be unfair to refund you, but they're sure you got something "really good" for your purchase.

Used to be fun, In the new update it's just pay-to-win Clash Royale was a great game, but now it's almost impossible to level up your cards unless you spend money. They removed chests and the event shop, and the Pass Royale gives you way less rewards than before. Everything is focused on making players pay. It's not fun anymore when progress is so slow and unfair. Bring back the old system!

Used to be amazing before when it was simple: cards that can only level up by playing the game and not by micro transactions.Now, it's not like the game is totally pay to win, but you just have to grind enough and be lucky enough to find opponents who have skill. The evolution feature is the worst of all. I stopped playing at 7.3k trophies because 90% of my losses were due to people using those "evolved" cards, champions, etc. There's no balance between the new cards and the classic ones.

Absolutely DO NOT start playing this game. The game uses a lot of psychological tricks to trick players into spending money. New cards will be introduced, and match-making will pair players who don't spend money on the new card up against players who do. In one mode where only 1/4 decks can POSSIBLY have that card, I've been consistently facing it 50~75% of the time. This defies random chance (aka. bad luck). The game is PURPOSELY designed to be unbalanced and less fun unless you pay.

The game fell off. I played it since it's very release, been a frequent player over the years, and I would have considered paying for this game worth it back then, which I did. But with these wild changes and constant mistakes they have been making over these years, especially as of lately, I can no longer say the same. With a game that puts itself as pay to win as much as it can, I would not even consider adding a single penny to it. +1 star for the fun it used to give me.

I've recently got back into the game after playing on and off for 9+ years to be reminded of the reason I dropped the game to begin with. It's a good concept fallen into the hands of the wrong people. The game is enjoyable in custom matches against friends but it's not designed for you to get to the top without spending any money. At some point, you will only face overleveled cards that result in an negative elixir trade, even if you defend perfectly. Sad to see a great game become P2W trash.

I played this game sine it was first released. Now, it is full of bug. I turn off my phone for 1 min and when I re-opened the game, 330 trophies was gone. Efforts and time that i spent more than an hour on this game was gone in a mere few seconds. I asked supercell for my lost trophies and they said that they will give me back the lost trophies, which they didn't, and they are now refusing to talk to me. Well played SUPERCELL.

It used to be fun, now it feels like a scam after Supercell got greedy. It takes more than a year to max out one deck, or hundreds of dollars. But that doesn't allow you to enjoy the game because you get locked into that deck. And the card and tower levels make a huge difference. They all cost a lot to upgrade. And even if you manage to get something together, Supercell will add a new level that is more costly than before. I've played for 6 years now, but it's become really disappointing.

Download this game only if you're sure you can treat it as a casual pastime. It's designed to be addictive. Personally, I've never spent money on it, and I recommend you don’t either. While paying can speed up card upgrades, it’s ultimately useless when it comes to winning; the level of script is just too high. The only way to stay competitive is to buy the new cards released each month, which are purposely designed to break the game. I advise against playing it if you have low self-control.

I always return to this game, I farm out cards, take a break, always enjoyed it, I welcomed the addition of the pass. They keep adding more asks and ways to spend money, creating more problems which can be solved with money, more things that can be accelerated with money. Now there is a pass on top of your pass behind which is hidden a new way to upgrade cards. It's moving away from a game towards a pay to win simulator. I am dissapointed because it's a really enjoyable game.

the latest update is just awful, with the same pace of the game, I started getting much less cards and money, I am forced to enter the battle more often. also, in the battle itself the units became faster than a slingshot in 2 by feel. cards disappeared from inventory. in general, the last update really spoiled the game, discouraging me from playing it

Personally, I find that this game is alright. It brought about a new genre of games altogether and generally revolutionised the gaming scene. Anyway, this game is great in its combat, system, and balancing. However, it falls short of 5* as they took many methods of getting gems and other really convenient functions (ie quests). Also, clan wars sucks :( Good game though.

This game is tripping balls. I just got to Arena 11 and had a very hard time. People were using over leveled cards that you couldn't even get until later on. It's quite obvious this game is p2w, and I tried to play without spending money, but I had to succumb. I tried to buy the Arena 11 special offer, but it wouldn't even let me. It just said something went wrong and greyed out until the offer ran out. Also, with the recent level 15 and evolutions update, this game is going downhill fast.

I've played this game since it first came out 9 years ago! I have really enjoyed it. But this new update is the stupidest direction supercell could have gone for CR. getting rid of chests ?!? something that has been in the game since day 1 WTH. Then ontop of that they get rid of the events shop. making it a hell of a lot harder for FTP players to obtain what they want. Suposedly they added some of that stuff into the free pass, but honestly whats the difference? Greed really does kill games!

Oh boy, where to begin. There are countless videos on the latest updates. Summed up: HUGE shift in greed, destroyed a very popular game zust to get even more money. Big nerfs to the economy, if you want to spend 100 plus dollars on a dying game then do it. If not, its a time waste and you can't compete without spending money because of levels. Also extremely annoying meta and overalla bad experience.

Loved the game, until a glitch froze my screen and kept the game running in the background. When I finally got control again, in game purchases had already occured and the app was trying to access my google wallet. Very dissapointed in this turn of events. Farming for certain types of currency in game is a long process. To have a glitch waste all of my time spent.... Is frustrating. ABSOLUTELY DO NOT RECOMMEND!!

Monotonous and not dynamic game. After a while you can't improve if you don't follow some patterns in terms of possible card combinations. Somehow it forces you to use combinations of cards that take away your freedom of choice. Some cards are very unbalanced. The main purpose of the game is to make the users pay for the prizes. Money rules the game. It also fails a lot due to internal errors. The new war update made everything even worse.

Was fun. I played 6 years. Spent hundreds of $ and more hours than I care to imagine. They added champions and I dealt with it and even defended their choices, but now they've added evolutions and level 15. It's pay to win, it's unbalanced and horribly repetitive. Was once great. I've sent emails to devs, tried to convey what I'm sure most of you will get from these reviews, but they've killed the game. I can't imagine why they've done this, but I'm done.

It was undoubtedly the best game I had ever played, capturing my heart and imagination with its immersive story and engaging mechanics that kept me coming back for more. However, over the last few years, the developers have complicated the experience significantly, introducing numerous changes and updates that have made it less enjoyable. Their primary focus seems to have shifted toward monetization, as they continually implement new features that require players to fork out additional money. It

I am updating my rating to 1 star because of the blatant deception in matchmaking. I haven’t played a real human since December. Supercell is using "ghost clans"—opponents show a clan name during the match, but afterward, they have no clan and the clan itself doesn't exist. This is a fraudulent way to trick players into thinking the game is active. ​These bots use scripted emotes (like the firecracker heart or king sweat) and have impossible stats (20k wins but no 'years played' badge).

Terrible update. this new social tab is clunky and unwanted. Who thought this was a good idea? Have to click to get to chat and then click to get out of chat. Terrible UI that should have never been approved.

Pretty good game. Except for the 2v2, almost 30 to 50% of my losts, in 2v2 it is because player disconnection. So when that happens it is just a 1v2, do something to fix the problem. Penalty players, only allow one enemy team player to attack, duplicate the juice and the cards to the remaining player, pause the game, drop a tie, etc. So many things, after more than a year of no playing the game, this is still not fixed, a real shame

Game was fun but very predictable. When you get close to leveling up you lose about 5 matches to bring you back down. Compete against people more then double your castle level. Unevenly matched a lot! People that pay real money to play get the advantage. I played when it first came out & it was the same so I deleted it.. I downloaded it again & it never changed. Update just deleted it again. Supercell is the worse games to download!

The game is heading in the wrong direction. Imagine if this game was open source and maintained by people interested in the game. But every update since clan wars work is pretty much just about earning more money, especially since they added season passes to the game. This might be the time I stop playing. The game is too much about earning money. It's not fun, but it's addictive.

Opponent is either 1-3 lvl higher or lower. This game nowadays more frustrating than entertaining. Spineless strategy, autometically set by server, hardly allows to win. If same lavel also, opponent selected such a way that they have advantage with winning cards. Supercell team, it is not very soon you will loose players. Earning money is one thing, but CHEATING in the name of free startegy game is another. If you have guts set the program so players will get opponent with same strength. 😠👎

It was great before the update for clan wars 2. Nothing makes sense! Clan wars earlier were much more simple and easier to under stand but beside that, I think Clash Royale is an amazing game to play with family and friends! You can befriend other players and they can help during clan wars! Overall, its a great game! :)

For new players that want to get this game: It only fun for the first 3 days. After that, you HAVE TO spend minimum $12 every month if you want to enjoy the game still. The servers are terrible, lots of lost connections, lags, and errors. The only way to get chest (this is the only free source of getting new cards and gold thus you can proggress in game) is by playing strict competitive games which you more likely to lose and get nothing. Dev is getting greedy. The game is not worth it.
the most money hungry greedy company I've ever witnessed. addicting game so they get away with it

used to be a fun little game to burn time on but over the years they've steadily gone about removing all the game modes, store options and progression to F2P players while raising the price of everything in the app. I've spent money on the game in the past but can't imagine why someone would spend more money for less on any of the new offerings. I've uninstalled after the final straw of removing game modes that have existed for years. Sad to see supercell kill everything they touch.

this game isn't just p2w it's pay to play the game is soo unbalanced adding level 16 cards was the worst move and they thought yes let's add heros to balance it AND SOMEHOW THAT MADE THE SITUATION EVEN WORSE
Great game but the game is pay to win. I'm over here at level 11 and my opponent is at level 15. How do I stand a chance bruh.

The season pass introduced on april 3rd 2023 totally messed up the experience. Not only is more expensive but also sucks.The game is grindy as it is, pass royale offered a few options to at least level up certain cards of your choice each month, option that is still somehow there, but with seasonal cards, which is a no no. I just uninstalled the game, have been playing from the very begining, it's a shame that greed ruined what was an entertaining game

I come back to the game and is bad this is now pay to win can't move to next arena and i want to use little prince but please give another buff to little prince or bring his healt up for ability and the character if will make a difference for free to play against p2w

Hello there! Im here just to report about a Problem im having. Usually whenever I play a match of somewhat. The game crashes and immidieatly closes. No matter what i did. It never stopped. I hope there can be a solution to this! Your game i outstanding and I hope this can be resolved so I can go back into playing it. Thank you for reading this.

Pls introduce a permanent game mode for old style CR. My idea, a game mode with all cards but no evos, no heros, maybe no champions. Would then balance that game mode as if they are balancing the base of the game, then balance the rest based on the normal game mode. I know you need money to run the game so this game mode should give much less rewards and have a separate trophy count. I think player engagement would be higher. This for fun to og, normal for rewards. Money to speed up.
don't play if you don't have money to spend in this game otherwise you get trashed by the guys having money to spend
Great game especially if you like a several second delay between attack selection and start of attack.

I can agree, this game is fun and addictive, but it literally doesn't work at all for players with Android phones that despite being compatible, still have the app crash every 5 minutes, making it impossible to play any normal matches without the game crashing, and you coming back on to see the match you entered already be finished. This makes new players stray away from the game, as they can't complete a regular match, because their app crashes, the match continues, and they come back to a loss

If you think about getting back into this game after not playing for good while: Don't! Before it was manageable as f2p or by only buying the pass each month, but now with the evolutions which cost 10,- each and the changes to pass it's impossible to catch up without dumping a ton of money into it. I had pretty decent card levels for the decks I've played but it's hard to have fun when you're constantly outleveled and out evolutioned. Last time they added higher levels it was at least adjusted!

It was really, really fun for a few days. Then you hit an incredible wall where you just can't get further. It's obvious this wall exists to try and get you to spend money. You win less and started raging more, until you cave in and spend money in the hopes of winning again. I eventually just asked myself: "Why am I still playing this game if it's just making me angry?"
